correctness.rationale: The standard monomial basis is finite. Frobenius maps each basis monomial to its \(p^r\)-dilate or zero, and distinct surviving exponent vectors cannot cancel. This gives \(q^{N-s_r}\) choices for \(z\) with \(z^{p^r}=0\). The \(p\)-primary unit group is finite abelian, and second differences of \(\log_p |U[p^r]|\) recover the exact cyclic multiplicities.
